action.objective: Verify reserved candidate Nxb7 (c5b7); if sound, commit it next.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search gave c5b7 exact 104, top candidate and reserved for verification. Its PV Nxb7 Nf6 Bxf6 gxf6 grabs b7 pawn while trading the dark bishop. Verifying single candidate with reserved 2000 nodes at max depth to check safety and tactical refutation.
